How does the update loop work in Urho3D?

The engine runs a main loop with these events per frame:

```
1. E_BEGINFRAME        — frame starts
2. E_UPDATE            — main game logic (variable timestep)
3. E_POSTUPDATE        — after main update
4. E_RENDERUPDATE      — rendering prep
5. E_POSTRENDERUPDATE  — after render prep, before actual render
6. E_ENDFRAME          — frame ends

Physics (fixed timestep, may run 0-N times per frame):
   E_PHYSICSPRESTEP
   E_PHYSICSCOLLISION  (for each collision pair)
   E_PHYSICSPOSTSTEP
```

Use E_UPDATE for gameplay logic:
```cpp
SubscribeToEvent(E_UPDATE, URHO3D_HANDLER(MyApp, HandleUpdate));

void MyApp::HandleUpdate(StringHash eventType, VariantMap& eventData)
{
    float dt = eventData[Update::P_TIMESTEP].GetFloat();
    // Move, animate, check input, update UI...
}
```

Or use LogicComponent::Update(float timeStep) — same thing but per-component.
FixedUpdate runs at fixed physics rate (default 60 Hz). Use for physics-dependent logic.
